s.note: Crisp fries with a tangy pink sauce.
s.how: Bake the fries on two trays at 220C, turning once, until deep gold and crisp. Start the sauce with a squeeze of lemon juice and the tomato sauce, then whisk in the mayo, relish, mustard, paprika and garlic powder. Salt the hot fries and serve with a big bowl of sauce.

s.note: Mini beef patties with cheese and pickles, something on it, says Ed.
s.how: Roll the mince into 8 balls and season well. Smash each ball flat on a very hot griddle and cook 2 minutes until crusty, then flip and top with cheese. Toast the buns on the griddle. Build with sauce, mustard, onion, pickles and the patties and serve hot.

m.n: The Good Burger with Ed's sauce
m.note: Double beef patties, cheese and the pink sauce. It saves Good Burger.
m.how: Mix a squeeze of lemon with the tomato sauce, mayo and relish to make the sauce. Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well. Cook on a very hot griddle 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip. Toast the buns cut side down. Stack two patties per bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and lots of sauce.

m.note: Meatballs in red sauce with melted provolone on a long roll.
m.how: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot oiled pan, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic and simmer. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top. Grill until the cheese melts and bubbles, then finish with basil.

w.n: Ice cream truck getaway chocolate-dipped cones
w.note: Vanilla cones dipped in chocolate, the ones Ed pelts at the truck.
w.how: Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil gently and cool to room temperature. Scoop the ice cream firmly into the cones, pressing a ball on top, and freeze for 10 minutes. Dip each top in the chocolate, scatter with sprinkles and stand upright in a glass until set.

d.n: Grape Nose Boy grape soda spider
d.note: Grape soda over vanilla ice cream.
d.how: Drop two scoops of ice cream into each of 4 tall chilled glasses. Pour the soda slowly down the side so it foams up. Top with a few grape halves and serve with a long spoon and straw.
